# 05-software

Software requirements, architecture, units, verification, ML engineering. Pre-entry drafts; the controlled Part 6 lifecycle is specified in [WP-M-14](../01-management/WP-M-14-iso26262-6-implementation-specification.md) and not yet started.

Standard clauses: 26262-6, SWE.1–6, MLE.1–4, SUP.11.

![The 11 work products of this folder, one row each, with a chip at every gate G0 to G6 it is needed for, coloured by its status in the WP-M-00 register: 9 at G3, 2 at G4; 11 draft](index-status.svg)

*Drawn from [WP-M-00](../01-management/WP-M-00-work-product-register.md#3-register) §3 (Software level), which also has the clauses of each work product and the register for every folder.*
